LettrAPIKeyCredential.title: Lettr API Key
LettrAPIKeyCredential.x-credential-instructions: Create a Full Access API key in your Lettr dashboard under API Keys, then paste it without the Bearer prefix. Sending Only keys cannot read connection evidence or manage resources. NoClick sends it only to app.lettr.com. Connecting reads your sending domains and team information.

list_id.description: Optional list to add the contact to. Must be a list of your team, otherwise the response is `422` with `errors.list_id`.
list_id.title: List Id

properties.description: Custom property values. Each key must match a property defined for the team.
properties.title: Properties

double_opt_in.description: Double opt-in configuration. When provided, the contact receives a confirmation email and is created in `unverified` status until they click the confirmation link.
double_opt_in.title: Double Opt In

domain.description: The domain name to register (e.g., example.com)
domain.title: Domain

project_id.description: Project ID to create the template in. If not provided, uses the team's default project.
project_id.title: Project Id

folder_id.description: Folder ID to create the template in. Must belong to the same module as `purpose`. If not provided, the first folder of that module is used, and one is created when the project has none.
folder_id.title: Folder Id

html.description: HTML content for custom HTML templates. Required if `json` is not provided. Mutually exclusive with `json`.
html.title: Html

json.description: JSON content for Topol visual editor templates. Required if `html` is not provided. Mutually exclusive with `html`.
json.title: Json

purpose.description: Module the template belongs to. `transactional` templates are the ones you send single emails with; `campaign` templates are the ones the campaign builder can pick. Defaults to `transactional`.
purpose.title: Purpose

subject.description: Email subject line. Required when not using a template. When using `template_slug`, defaults to the template's subject (or template name as fallback). If provided alongside a template, overrides the template subject.
subject.title: Subject

bcc.description: Blind carbon copy recipient email addresses
bcc.title: Bcc

html.description: HTML content of the email. At least one of `html` or `text` is required, but providing both is recommended for best compatibility across email clients.
html.title: Html

text.description: Plain text content of the email. At least one of `html` or `text` is required, but providing both is recommended for best compatibility across email clients.
text.title: Text

amp_html.description: AMP HTML content for supported email clients
amp_html.title: Amp Html

project_id.description: Project ID containing the template. If not provided when using template_slug, the team's default project will be used.
project_id.title: Project Id

template_slug.description: Template slug to use for email content. When provided, the template's HTML will be used instead of the html field.
template_slug.title: Template Slug

template_version.description: Specific template version to use. If not provided, the active version will be used.
template_version.title: Template Version

tag.description: Tag for tracking and analytics. Automatically set from template_slug if not provided.
tag.title: Tag

metadata.description: Custom metadata attached to the email for tracking purposes
metadata.title: Metadata

headers.description: Custom email headers. Up to 10 headers allowed. Standard envelope headers (From, To, Subject, etc.), SparkPost internal headers (X-MSYS-API), and List-Unsubscribe and List-Unsubscribe-Post headers are managed by the system and cannot be set manually.
headers.title: Headers

substitution_data.description: Variables for template substitution in email content
substitution_data.title: Substitution Data

attachments.description: File attachments. When provided, each attachment must include name, type, and data.
attachments.title: Attachments

scheduled_at.description: The UTC date/time when the email should be sent. Must be at least 5 minutes in the future and within 30 days.
scheduled_at.title: Scheduled At

data.description: Base64 encoded file content (no line breaks)
data.title: Data

click_tracking.description: Enable click tracking for links in the email
click_tracking.title: Click Tracking

open_tracking.description: Enable open tracking via tracking pixel
open_tracking.title: Open Tracking

transactional.description: Mark email as transactional (not marketing). **Defaults to `true`.** Transactional mail bypasses unsubscribe suppression, so any send a recipient can opt out of must explicitly set this to `false`.
transactional.title: Transactional

inline_css.description: Inline CSS styles in HTML content
inline_css.title: Inline Css
